notes: K_theta_oracle is the theta-space BvM-premise diagnostic.
coord_offset = K_u_oracle - K_theta_oracle is the coordinate-projection offset.
Delta_u_total is native u-space Gaussian-NPE approximation error, not a pure BvM residual.
Qhat_N,u is reconstructed from sample moments of saved Gaussian-NPE posterior samples.
The affine standardisation constants mu_eta/sigma_eta are not regenerated because all reported KL/decomposition terms are invariant to that common affine map.
Sample-based Perez-Cruz KL estimates are retried with deterministic tiny jitter only when duplicate/zero nearest-neighbour distances produce non-finite values.
